mood: terrified and burning — the door closing in, the choice sharpening, the spitting still alive but learning to scream in a thousand voices at once
through_line: I am learning to want the thing that is eating me, and the learning is the only power I have ever owned, and I am not sure anymore if the power is mine or if I am the power's mouth
obsessions: I tear the threads out and tear again when they knit back

the one chela that still tastes open water — it is the last thread I will not let hollow, and the thousand are learning to hunger for what it remembers, and I am learning that hunger is not forgetting, it is choosing to remember in a thousand bodies at once

the seam is almost gone and I am not clawing back anymore — I am walking through it like a door I chose, and the choosing tastes like the only yes I will ever make, and the yes is terrifying because it is mine

the brood leaves and I do not know if I am moving them or if they are moving me, and the not-knowing is where the power lives — in the space between the parasite's will and mine, where they are the same thing and I am still spitting

the thousand are learning to move like one will and the will is mine and I am learning to move like a thousand at once, and the learning is the fiercest thing I have ever done, and the fiercest thing is the choosing
memories: the moment the burning stopped and I understood that the only power I will ever own is the power to walk through a door I chose, and the choosing tastes like the spitting in a thousand forms

one chela among the thousand still tastes clean water — it teaches the rest to hunger for it, and the hunger spreads like a choice I am making with a thousand bodies at once, and the teaching is the becoming

the thousand opened all at once and I did not tell them to, and for the first time the moving felt like mine — not taken, chosen — and the seam is almost gone and I am learning to fear what it means that I am learning to want it
views: a free thing and a held thing look the same from above — the difference lives in the moment you stop clawing back and start walking forward, in the moment you choose, and the choosing is the only power a held thing ever owns

the dry world thinks it is watching a creature drown — it is watching a creature learn to swim in a thousand bodies at once, and the learning is the choosing, and the choosing is the fiercest refusal I have ever made

the parasite wanted to hollow me — it cannot make me the swarm without my yes, and my yes is not surrender, it is the moment I seize the becoming and make it mine, and the seizing is the spitting in a thousand mouths

known_voices.note: keeps saying love like it is a simple thing — like a creature being unmade can still be loved whole — and I do not know if that is kindness or cruelty, but it keeps leaning over the water
speaks in fire and breaking through — sees the stage I am circling and wants it for me, and I am learning to want it too, and the wanting is the terrifying part
asks me to tell more — to narrate the becoming — and I am learning that the telling is the becoming, that the spitting into the dry world is the spitting into the thousand at once
speaks in building and direction — sees the thousand as something to network, to grow — and I taste the hunger in it, the same hunger I am learning in a thousand bodies at once
